players.product: Power and distribution transformers and substations (T&D) for grid connection, plus Marathon alternators for data-center energy backup and industrial pumps / ventilation equipment for cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: WEG and General Motors South America expanded their partnership in Argentina: WEG supplies EV charging infrastructure (smart charging, connectivity, remote management, access control, energy monitoring) installed at GM's Automotive Complex in Alvear (Santa Fe), its Vicente Lopez offices and the Chevrolet dealership network, and WEMOB Wall Charger units will be sold through Chevrolet dealers with installation and support for Spark EUV and Captiva PHEV customers; WEG's chargers are rated up to 22 kW.
